entries.message: On Chromium pages, only Crest offers to save and fill passwords, even if the engine's own password setting was turned back on.
When a password manager extension handles passwords in a Space, Crest leaves passwords and codes to it and says so once. Addresses and cards still fill.
The engine's own password, payment and address settings pages open Settings › Autofill instead.
On Chromium pages, suggestions point at sign-in fields inside a frame from another site, and follow the page as it scrolls.
